label: def:ccg-cosimplicial-identities
title: Cosimplicial identities for the jet/descent face and degeneracy maps
html:
Definition. The coface maps \delta^i (composites of jet prolongation with Čech face maps) and codegeneracy maps \sigma^j (composites of descent with Čech degeneracy maps) satisfy the cosimplicial identities:

  \delta^j \circ \delta^i = \delta^i \circ \delta^{j-1} \;(i < j),
  \quad
  \sigma^j \circ \sigma^i = \sigma^i \circ \sigma^{j+1} \;(i \leq j).

They also satisfy the mixed identities. Each case reduces either to disjoint-support commutation or to the retraction \mathfrak{d}_{n+1} \circ \ell_n = \mathrm{id}.
